_readme: House policy parameters for the suitability engine.
WHY THIS FILE EXISTS AND WHY IT IS NOT CODE
The client's signed risk profile states a classification ('Moderado') and two
compatible product families in prose. It contains NO numbers: no maximum
position size, no minimum cash, no cap on any asset class.
Every threshold below is therefore an ASSUMPTION made by this implementation,
not a rule the client agreed to. Keeping them here, versioned and readable,
means an advisor can see exactly which part of a finding came from the client
document and which part came from a parameter that a compliance team could
reasonably set differently. Each finding produced by the engine cites the
parameter it used and repeats its source.
The one figure below that is NOT a house choice is
qualified_investor_threshold_brl: R$1,000,000 is the CVM definition of an
investidor qualificado, and it is marked as such.

moderado.label: Moderado
moderado.source: Client risk profile statement, 'Classificação do Perfil de Investimento'

idle_cash.rationale: Cash beyond a working reserve earns nothing while the policy rate is in double digits. The threshold is a house parameter; the profile document sets none.

concentration.rationale: The profile calls for 'uma estratégia de diversificação'. It gives no limit, so these are house parameters chosen to make that qualitative instruction checkable.

eligibility.source: CVM Resolution 30 definition of investidor qualificado
eligibility.note: Visible net worth at XP is only part of a client's financial assets. A breach is an eligibility REVIEW, never an assertion that the client is unqualified.

equity_screen.rationale: Operationalises 'ações de empresas consolidadas que historicamente pagam dividendos anuais' from the profile. Yield and event count are measured from actual dividend history, not assumed.

loss_review.rationale: A position down more than half since purchase is surfaced for review. Not a sell signal on its own - it is paired with profile alignment before any action is proposed.

recommendation_limits.rationale: A letter that proposes everything proposes nothing. The engine ranks and truncates, and always reports how many candidates were considered and how many were shown.

_why: The challenge caps the letter at two pages. Two A4 pages of Portuguese business
correspondence is roughly 750-850 words, and less once charts occupy space. The
engine currently produces 27 items across findings, recommendations and attribution
lines - far more than fits.
Something must be cut, and WHO cuts is the whole thesis of this rewrite. If the
payload goes to the model whole and the prompt says 'keep it to two pages', the
model decides which of the client's findings he never hears about. That is exactly
the class of decision the deterministic layer exists to own.
So selection happens here, by rule, before the narration node sees anything. What
was dropped is counted and disclosed in the letter, never silently omitted.
A chart belongs next to the sentence it explains. Stacking them all at the
end turns the letter into a report with an appendix, and the reader has to
hold a paragraph in memory while walking back to the picture.
The composer is instructed to write five paragraphs in a fixed order, so the
placement is by index and deterministic. If a run produces fewer paragraphs
than the map expects, the leftover charts are appended rather than dropped,
and the renderer says so.
Paragraph 4 now carries the BEFORE/AFTER pair rather than the single ring. It sits
beside the proposals block, where the question it answers - "what would my
portfolio look like?" - is actually being asked. The detailed 13-position ring
moved to the annex: both cannot fit, and the pair is what the proposals need.
The consensus range chart moved to the annex once the buy/sell ideas block
entered the letter. Two pages hold two charts, and the macro paragraph already
states every figure that chart plotted - Selic 15,50% against a 15,00% median,
the 88,9 percentile, IPCA 6,10% against 5,55%. The two that stayed answer the
client's own questions: what happened to my money, and what should I do about
it. The consensus chart answers why the house thinks what it thinks, which is
the one a client is least likely to need in front of him.
_positions_note: The positions ring sits in the slot the coverage bar used to hold, at the
paragraph that proposes what to do. It answers the same question the bar
answered - how much money is sitting still - and also answers 'what do I
actually own', which the letter had never shown at all.
The coverage bar was not deleted. It carries a different message: how much
of the portfolio the reported return could be MEASURED over. That belongs
next to the sensitivity table in the advisor annex, which is where it now
renders. Two charts, two messages, each where its argument is being made.

_proposals_why: The 'Próximos passos' block is printed by the renderer from
plan.letter.recommendations, immediately after this paragraph. Paragraph 4
became a one-sentence lead-in rather than a wall of figures: the amounts,
dates and rates now live in the block, where the model cannot rephrase
them, drop one, or reorder them.
This was the paragraph the composer got wrong most often. One run argued
that high rates hurt fixed income two paragraphs before proposing to buy
post-fixed income, because it was left to infer a conclusion the engine

disclosures._why: Emitted as data so the renderer can fail when one is missing, rather than trusting a prompt to remember them.

required.text_pt: Rentabilidade passada não é garantia de rentabilidade futura.
Os dividend yields citados são apurados sobre os 12 meses encerrados na data de referência e não constituem projeção.
As posições em fundos refletem cotas informadas pelos gestores com data de 04/04/2024; os valores em reais são indicativos.
As sugestões desta carta são candidatas à análise do seu assessor e não constituem ordem de compra ou venda.
Aplicações em CDB contam com cobertura do FGC até os limites vigentes, por CPF e por instituição.
Onde a base de preços da XP diverge do fechamento de mercado, a carta reporta a diferença e mantém o valor do seu extrato.
